snippet.title: Little Planet 1.0 Announcement Trailer | XR Indies & Friends August 12 2025
snippet.description:
Little Planet leaves early access on October 30! It's launching as a free-to-play game, but if you have bought or plan to purchase before its 1.0 launch, you will receive a Founders Pack with $200 worth of in-game content included!

Little Planet on Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/little-planet-early-access/5749790791804399/?srsltid=AfmBOorgr3juvqWxnLYyzxLeDP6Zd6A0vDdtX2ZKsysk6z8JZU0ODTXs
